mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_audit (biz_type, biz_id, status, hit_level, hit_words, operator_id, reason) VALUES (#{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{status}, #{hitLevel}, #{hitWords}, #{operatorId}, #{reason})
mapper.update: UPDATE content_audit SET status = #{status}, reason = #{reason}, operator_id = #{operatorId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
